R7AH-bear-backcountry-0002.name: By Jackfish Creek
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 470 m SE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2023 (fire G60666), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 13 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Jackfish Creek 70 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: M.U.s 7-38 and 7-39. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 7-1/23.
Route crosses provincial park: Omineca Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 3 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.76306, -124.67787, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.6 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 214 m, about 134 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 280 m NW of the spot at 887 m (55.7907, -124.60398). Water: Jackfish Creek 190 m S (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 298 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 16 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
